_comentario: Datos de origen para tools/gen_palabras.py --libro firstwords («First Words», ver notes/06-first-words.md). Este fichero SÍ se edita a mano; content/firstwords/generated-*.tex NO. Trimestre 4 (verano), días 196-260: una frase al día, de dos palabras (semanas 40-43) a tres (44-47) y cuatro (48-52). Son decodable text: cada palabra se lee sonido a sonido con todo lo aprendido, o es una tricky word de los viernes de primavera, o un nombre del reparto.

actividad.prompt: Amy is packing her suitcase for London: T-shirts, shorts, her paints -- and a photo of Pip! Colour Amy and her suitcase.
the taxi taking the Browns away, and Amy waving goodbye.
Dani and his little green suitcase, with an orange dinosaur on it.

actividad.adivinanza: She has got a ponytail, a little brother and a dog called Toby, and she reads two books in English on holiday. Who is she?

actividad.prompt: Colour the family's suitcases, ready at the door -- and Toby, who wants to come too!
The family arrives at Grandma's house in the village. In the patio, there is a lemon tree and a hen house. Colour Grandma waiting at the door.
Bigotes is Andrés' cat: white and orange, with very long whiskers. Colour him, and draw his whiskers.
Toby sleeping under the table, in the shade.

actividad.instruccion: Match each animal to its sound.
actividad.prompt: Grandma's five hens in the patio.
Colour dinner in the patio, under the lemon tree, when the stars come out.
A postcard from Amy! On the front, there is a tall clock tower and a red bus with two floors. “It rains every day!” she says. Colour the postcard.
a red London bus with two floors, like the one on Amy's postcard. Beep, beep!
Dad cooking a paella in the patio, and Toby watching him.

actividad.adivinanza: Toby does it to Dani's face, and Lucía does it to her ice cream. Before she sticks the stamp on her postcard for Amy, she does it to the stamp too! What does she do?

actividad.prompt: Colour Lucía's postcard for Amy: Grandma's village, with the church, the houses, the river and the sun.
A picnic by the river! Grandma rests on a big blanket, with a basket of sandwiches and a plate of peaches. Colour it.
Lucía swims in the river. Colour her, and draw the big rock in the middle of the river, where she sits in the sun.
Dani looking at five little fish, swimming between the stones.

actividad.instruccion: Match each word to its opposite.
actividad.prompt: Grandma telling a very old riddle by the river, and Dani grinning.
Colour the little boat made of wood and a leaf, floating down the river -- and Lucía and Dani, who made it.
Andrés shows the children his beehives. He puts on a white suit, yellow gloves and a hat with a net. Colour him and his bees!
a bee on a flower. If a bee lands on you, stay very still!
the bees buzzing round the flowers.

actividad.adivinanza: I am black and yellow, I fly from flower to flower, and I make honey. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour Dani, standing like a statue, with a bee on his arm.
Grandma shows them seven stars that look like a saucepan: four make the pan, and three make the handle. Colour Grandma, Lucía, Dani and the stars.
A shooting star is a tiny bit of dust that burns in the sky. Colour it, and draw the moon next to it.
the village with all the lights off, and the stars shining over the houses.
Dani making a wish on a shooting star -- but he doesn't say it out loud!
Colour the family on their blanket in the grass, looking at the night sky full of stars.
The sky goes dark. Three big black clouds come over the hill, and the wind starts to blow. Colour the storm.
the storm outside the window, and Grandma's two candles on the table.
the patio after the storm: a big branch on the table, three lemons under it, and the sun shining again.

actividad.adivinanza: He is six, he loves dinosaurs, and he sips Grandma's lemonade with a straw. Who is he?

actividad.prompt: Colour the letter from Amy: the Browns are coming to the village!
actividad.banner: 230 pages read! After the storm, the sun!

actividad.prompt: It is festival week! Red and yellow flags go from the church tower to the town hall. Colour the village square.
Dani reads the festival poster on the door of the town hall. Colour him, and draw the poster: what does it say?
Dani eating six churros with sugar!

actividad.instruccion: Match each animal to its home.
actividad.prompt: Lucía, Dani and Martín reading their riddle on the stage.
Colour the fireworks over the village at midnight.
Amy sits by the river with her sketchbook and draws what she can see: the old mill with its wheel, the river and the church tower. Colour it with her.
Sam holding one of Grandma's hens, very carefully -- and the eggs in the nest.
Amy's ice cream with three scoops: pink, brown and yellow.

actividad.adivinanza: She comes from England, she has got red curly hair, and she swims very fast in the river. Who is she?

actividad.prompt: Colour dinner in Grandma's patio with the two families -- and Mr Brown's scones!
Lucía and Amy plan a treasure hunt for Dani, Sam and Martín. Colour their map of the patio, with an X for the treasure!
The X is on a big stone, next to the lemon tree. Colour it, and draw the first clue, under the stone!
the boys reading the second clue, tied to a branch of the lemon tree.

actividad.instruccion: Match each animal to its baby.
actividad.prompt: the box full of treasure under the table: swimming goggles and sweets!
Colour the three treasure hunters -- Dani, Sam and Martín -- with their new swimming goggles!
Andrés gives Lucía a jar of honey. On the label, there is a bee with a magnifying glass! Colour the jar.
the car back home in the city, with Toby in the window.
Pip's cage on the round table again, next door.

actividad.adivinanza: Martín sends Dani a letter, with a secret message. Dani is very happy! What does he do with his mouth?

actividad.prompt: Colour Lucía's comic of the summer, in three pictures: the river, the bees and the fireworks.
Dani is going to start at the big school! Mum buys him a red rucksack with a green T. rex on the front. Colour it.
Lucía's tip for Dani: read it slowly, with your finger under the words! Colour Dani, and draw a picture in his book.
the stationery shop: a blue notebook, purple pencils, and a pen for Sam.

actividad.instruccion: Match each word to its opposite.
actividad.prompt: Sam in his English school uniform, with his crooked tie!
Colour everything that Lucía needs for the first day: her bag, her books, her lunch box and her pencils.
School starts again! Paco says hello to everyone at the gate, and Dani and Sam are in Marta's class. Colour them at the gate.
Dani zipping up his new bag, with the T. rex on it.
Lucía and Amy's new classroom, with a map of the world on the board.

actividad.adivinanza: You do it with your mouth and with music. Pip does it every morning, and Amy and Lucía do it on the first day of school! What do they do?

actividad.prompt: Colour everybody saying goodbye -- and the big book that says “I can read!”
